$Comment: The Horseman's Reins: the Headless Horseman's black horse as a player's own mount, through Alec's Tamework. They drop only where Tamework runs, from his Boss Kill Claim (ZiggfreedCommon/Lootables/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins_Chase.json and _Chase_Hard.json, very rarely on the normal ride and now and then on the hard one; change the odds there), and the same roll puts the Horseman's Steed in the player's Tamework roster. Held, a right-click opens that roster, where SUMMON calls the steed and DISMISS puts it away; F rides it, for its owner only. This file is a plain item on every server: Server/Patchwork/Patches/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins_Patch.json gives it the right-click only where Tamework runs, since an item naming Tamework's interaction would stop a server without it at boot, and Server/Tamework/Items/Commands/Hallows_Eve_Horsemans_Reins.json ties it to the roster. Old Jack buys a spare pair back for Hallow Sweets where Tamework runs (ZiggfreedCommon/ShopEntries/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve_Offer_Sell_Horsemans_Reins.json). It wears the game's leather strap model on this pack's black texture (tools/derive_art.py draws the texture and the icon). Legendary quality frames the prize; MaxStack 1 keeps each in its own slot, and DropOnDeath false keeps it in the bag, since the Reins are the only way to call the steed.
